reference_classes.procedure: No manufactured sampling floor. Before lock, pin an allowance for same-target-year revision/vintage dispersion, measurement/concept/coverage bridges and half the published rounding unit. Variation between outcome years is not measurement uncertainty. Numeric allowance remains unset; this blocks freeze.

Proposal from design §5.3: |ln(candidate/reference)|; survey-design replicates where available, otherwise household-disjoint half-splits; round(mean + 4*sd, 3), at least 20 events on the weaker half, stabilized tolerance <= ln(1.5). A fixed prospective pooling ladder partitions ineligible cells as report-only. Zero references require a separately registered absolute-scale rule.

uncertainty_treatment.common: Simultaneous 95% confidence bounds with Bonferroni over the frozen cell family; include reference, estimation, design and simulation uncertainty. Monte Carlo standard error below one-tenth of each tolerance. Insufficient precision is inconclusive. Never drop a failed/unsupported cell after outcomes.
uncertainty_treatment.candidate: Resample OP5 housing units by the ACS design and GQ persons separately; resample OP3 donors under their own replicate designs; refit/perturb parity seeds and the fertility law within documented estimation support; propagate mortality/exit and timing bridge uncertainty; repeat person-keyed simulation seeds. Preserve mother/child and family clustering. OP5 resampling applies because this gate projects from OP5.

pass_conjunction: All frozen eligible maternal-age and share-male simultaneous bounds inside source-class tolerances; all support/MC conditions met.
No known exposure is called independent prediction. Regression failure blocks its corresponding admission; no seed or tolerance selection.
Named newborn-link and persistent-parity conformance prerequisites pass separately; married-mother share is report-only.

power_procedure.name: Nested clustered equivalence and misspecification simulation for birth cells
power_procedure.operating_characteristic: Proposal: >=0.90 probability of the full pass conjunction under a predeclared concordant scenario, and >=0.90 probability of a fail or inconclusive result under each predeclared substantively wrong age/sex profile. Reviewer chooses effect sizes before outcomes; no claim of demonstrated power.
inputs: Pinned critical-cell event/exposure sizes or blinded authorized counts; same-year vintage/rounding allowances; design effects and covariance; fitted-law/parity uncertainty; OP5/OP3 clustering; simulation seed variance.
procedure: Run an invented-data effective-size/design-effect grid; perturb one age/sex profile at a time and jointly; refit only development data.
Nest survey/fitted-law resampling and repeated projection seeds, form Bonferroni simultaneous bounds, estimate the full-conjunction probability and binomial Monte Carlo interval.
Freeze required effective sizes, alternatives and pooling ladder prospectively; absence of matched counts or >=0.90 support blocks feasibility approval.
